findings.title: §3.5j Stable-Rust clippy gate codification omits the required `--features` flag — leads reviewers to false-RED diagnosis (carried from R2 L12-R2-OBS-1; promoted to MINOR after R3 re-verification)
findings.where: .addl/dispatch-conventions.md:380 §3.5j: 'orchestrator (+ implementer agents preferred) MUST also run `cargo +stable clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`'
findings.evidence: Running the literal §3.5j command without the required `--features benten-eval/testing,benten-engine/test-helpers,benten-graph/testing` flag at HEAD 6c21e4f5 returns 11+ compile errors (E0432 unresolved import benten_eval::testing / E0433 failed to resolve / E0560 no field `expected_handler_id` / E0599 no method `expect_event_emitted`) against integration tests that import the feature-gated `pub mod testing` modules. CI ci.yml line ~141 correctly passes the feature flags. The §3.5l (added 2026-05-16) at dispatch-conventions.md:397-399 DOES mirror the CI invocation correctly with the --features flag; §3.5j proper does not. Net effect: a reviewer running the §3.5j-literal command sees compile-errors + may file a false-RED finding (or, worse, conclude the workspace doesn't compile and disposition something larger). PROMOTED from R2-OBS-1 to R3-MIN because (a) R2 raised it as a §3.5j wording-amendment suggestion; (b) R2 fix-pass did not address it; (c) it has now been recurrence-verified in this R3 lens run as a real false-RED trap. Per pim-N-prior-phase-pim-explicit-preflight, codification drift on a documented gate is a §3.6g class — the same risk that triggered §3.6g.
findings.disposition: FIX-NOW — orchestrator-direct text amendment at .addl/dispatch-conventions.md:380 — change 'cargo +stable clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' to 'cargo +stable clippy --workspace --all-targets --features benten-eval/testing,benten-engine/test-helpers,benten-graph/testing -- -D warnings' + add a sentence 'The --features flag mirrors CI's invocation at .github/workflows/ci.yml; without it, integration tests consuming feature-gated `pub mod testing` modules surface 11+ E0432/E0433/E0560/E0599 compile errors and the reviewer may file a false-RED.' Also apply same amendment to the §3.5h pre-push 5-check description if it lacks the flag. ~3 LOC edit. Composes with: §3.5l (line 397/399) which already has the flag — this brings §3.5j into alignment with §3.5l + CI. Already-codified §3.6g (prior-phase pim-N as explicit pre-flight checklist) supports treating this as a self-application: §3.5j codifies a gate; the gate's command-line must be runnable-as-codified.
findings.anchor: R2 L12-R2-OBS-1; R3 re-verification at HEAD 6c21e4f5. The 4-instance recurrence of §3.5j-class gate-discipline failures (PR #240 cycle described in §3.5j body) is the same risk class — a CI gate is only as effective as its locally-runnable mirror; if the mirror command is broken, the gate becomes orchestrator-only + the implementer agents § 3.5j addresses lose their pre-flight.
